title: Battle of Cádiz (1656)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Cádiz (1656)", at revision 1370109471, opens: "The Battle of Cádiz was an operation in the Anglo–Spanish War (1654–1660) in which an English fleet destroyed or captured the ships of a Spanish treasure fleet off Cádiz." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870824, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1656 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
